$comment: Nissan 350Z (Z33) with a GM LS1 or LS3: the hardware real builds use, researched 2026-09-29 from the vendors' own product pages and install guides (Sikky Manufacturing, Hinson Motorsports, TDR Performance, Wiring Specialties); every page cited is saved and quote-checked. Primary sources are the listings themselves; prices are as listed on 2026-09-29 in USD. Covered: engine and transmission mounts, pans, driveshafts, headers, cooling, power steering, fuel lines, clutch hydraulics, the CD00x adapter route that keeps the Nissan 6-speed, car-specific harnesses, standalone ECU packages and CAN-bus cluster modules. Generic LS hardware (GM PCMs, T56/TR6060 gearboxes, clutches, universal pans and other LS-to-CD009 adapters) is in the common LS file. Not found: which factory GM pan clears the Z33 (both kit makers use their own rear-sump pans), an LS route for the RE5R05A automatic, and an RHD harness. CX Racing's site blocks automated reading, so its kits are not included. Merged 2026-09-29 with the hardware common to every LS swap (GM PCM, Chevrolet Performance and Holley ECU routes, standalone harnesses, GM and Tremec gearboxes, clutches, fuel regulators), which a separate research pass sourced; those parts repeat in each LS swap file until Phase 3 moves them into parts/.

notes: DE vs HR cars: no vendor lists separate DE and HR versions of the mounts, pans, headers or driveshafts (TDR titles its parts 2003-2009); the differences are at the gearbox (Sikky sells separate DE and HR CD00X adapter kits, with different dowel positions and clearancing) and in the wiring (Wiring Specialties prices its harnesses for 2003-2006 and charges extra for 2007-2008 chassis). Gearbox routes: T56, T56 Magnum or TR6060 (generic, in the LS file) with a Sikky or TDR crossmember, or the car's own CD00x with the Sikky CD00X adapter, TM03 bracket, CD009 driveshaft and CD009 clutch master kit. Hinson's kit mentions the stock Pontiac GTO shifter and keeps the stock radiator. CAN: the Wiring Specialties LS1 harness has its own CANbus controller; the RevCAN2 modules add cluster and A/C functions for an OEM PCM; Haltech Rebel packages drive the dash over CAN; Hinson's complete package uses a Nissan CAN gateway. Traction and stability control are reported not to work (Wiring Specialties).
